lessons.lesson: Signal Quality NAV can amplify unstable or non-executable ranking effects; pair it with executable NAV before promotion.
A bad-label factor can identify weak broad candidates, while V2-selected candidates with that label may still beat lower-ranked replacements.
Top3 selection changed materially across train windows, so robustness must include rank stability and direct rank-return separation.
max_per_ind=2 helped Top3 average but hurt tail risk and Top5; treat as risk shaping, not alpha.

Liquidity-structure ideas that require free_float_ratio cannot be validated from the current raw parquet proxy; coverage is 1.549817%, so a new data source or redesigned proxy is required before retesting.

close_position_in_range and close_position_gap_interaction improved strict rolling Signal Quality NAV in the 2026-07-10 round 4 repaired retry, but drawdown worsened and executable NAV was not validated; preserve as research_only and require executable NAV, ablation, and full-pool diagnostics before promotion.
